## How the classes work

Every session has the same rhythm: a 45-minute framework block, a 2-hour guided build on your team's own product, a 45-minute critique, and a 30-minute milestone review. The class page is the framework block and the lab guide in one place. Read it before the session if you can; during the session you will spend most of the time building.

The simulators are safe to play with. The practice questions explain why each wrong option is wrong. The lab checklist is saved in your browser, so you can come back to it between sessions.
